description: Synthetic fixture of ordinary indexed notes plus generated research/advice/transcript records. This models store shapes, not sampled private user data or measured production traffic. Frozen before the first corpus-breakdown run.

documents.text:
# Demo preparation checklist
Start the web app before the demonstration. Run browser tests after changing the page and verify the voice note button. Show a picture, then check the Jobs page. Ask the owner before enabling LAN mode. Record which models were configured so the next person can reproduce the demo. This checklist intentionally does not contain installation commands, model identifiers or account credentials.

# Vector retrieval overview
Embeddings represent text as numeric vectors so nearby meanings can be recalled even when their words differ. A retrieval system often combines keyword search with vector similarity. Query vectors and document vectors must use compatible representations. Approximate nearest-neighbor indexing trades some recall for speed as the collection grows. Evaluation should use queries with known relevant documents and keep tuning queries separate from held-out questions. An embedding model alone does not guarantee that an answer is correct. Retrieved passages need provenance and enough context to explain the claim. This overview does not prescribe a model or API setting for a particular application.

# Accessing a local service
A browser on another device needs the host's local network address and the service's listening port. Loopback addresses point to the requesting device itself. Authentication limits who can use a reachable service; firewall rules limit which connections can reach it. Plain HTTP does not provide transport encryption, even on a home network. Secure browser APIs may need HTTPS or a trustworthy local origin. Check the application's LAN-mode instructions before exposing its tools. A VPN or a second subnet can change reachability. These general notes do not specify this application's passcode settings.

# A job search routine
Keep a list of applications with company, role, date and next action. Review the list each week and prepare concise examples for interviews. Tailor a resume to the actual job requirements without inventing experience. A generated cover letter is a draft that the applicant should verify. Sending an application or contacting a recruiter requires the applicant's decision. Store only information needed to track progress, and avoid putting account credentials in notes.

# Python testing introduction
The tutorial explains unit tests, isolated temporary files and injected service fakes. Tests should demonstrate observable behavior rather than mirror each implementation line. Browser tests exercise the rendered page and require a browser runtime in addition to Python. A test that contacts a live service may fail for reasons unrelated to the change. Keep local fixtures deterministic and report which external dependencies were replaced. The transcript gives general testing advice, not this repository's runner command.
